Walk in interview for the post of Digital Media Designer
(Graphic Designer/Video Editor/ Animator)
Walk in interview for the post of Digital Media Designer (Graphic Designer/Video Editor/
Animator) in research project entitled “Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project” will be held
on 23 July 2026 at 10.00 am onwards.
Interested eligible candidate should report for the interview along with laptop with required
softwares, portfolio and supporting documents in room no 227, 2nd Floor, Dept of Environment
Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh along with duly filled application form. Skill test will be
held before the interview.
This post is purely on contract basis and co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post: Digital Media Designer (Graphic Designer/Video Editor/Animator/)
Number of Post -2
Salary: Rs. 31000/- per month (fixed)
Qualification:
Essential: Diploma or Degree in Graphic Designing / Animation / Mass Communication / Allied
discipline.
Desirable:
• Having applicable working experience in Script/Content Writing (Hindi/English), Adobe
Premiere Pro, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe after Effect, Adobe InDesign,
interior design, and related software, AI Generative Tools like Runway ML, Envato Elements,
Sora, short format content creation, social media analytics, camera handling and related
softwares
• Candidate should provide at least 1 recommendation letter and work experience in same field.
Job Description:
• A self-motivated, multi-skilled candidate is sought to join the project having good knowledge
of Graphic Design Skills, brainstorming creative designing ideas, Good interpersonal skills,
Ability to Work in Strict Deadlines, Researching and preparing rough drafts.
• Should be able to manage social media account for wider reach of IEC material.
• Able to understand brief provided and create high quality visual within given timelines
• Candidate should be available for immediate joining, if selected
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/ArWqH6P6WN3jE2i59 before
appearing for interview. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. The rules and regulations
as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency will govern the selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator E. Mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
